subject.title: fix(ci): include runtime resources in build artifact

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's new `dist-runtime-build` pack-and-smoke script as the CI artifact producer for `build-artifacts`?
rationale: The code review found no blocking defect and the artifact proof is strong, but replacing a raw CI tar command with a runtime smoke script is an automation-surface choice maintainers should explicitly accept before merge.

options.title: Accept With Exact-Head Gate
options.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance if the final head or merge queue keeps `build-artifacts` and the relevant CI checks green.

options.title: Request A Narrower Producer
options.body: Ask the author to simplify or split the smoke behavior if maintainers decide the artifact producer should stay lighter-weight.

options.title: Pause The PR
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want CI artifact packaging to own extracted-runtime smoke proof.

recommendation.title: Accept With Exact-Head Gate
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance if the final head or merge queue keeps `build-artifacts` and the relevant CI checks green.
